cut_rhythm.pattern: 11 scenes inside a screen-in-scene reel (only the inner edited video described; monitor bezel ignored, a sliver of monitor edge shows at the top of the crop). Slow calm start, a flurry of three very short scenes 7-9 (0.317s, 0.2s, 1.083s) as whip-cut camera-move burst at 28.8-30.4s on the words 'seamless camera movement', then two long holds (13.4s and 7.733s). Cuts follow phrases, not beats.

shots.camera_angle: none for most scenes: flat 2D UI/typography board; scenes 7-9 (28.8-30.4s) are a virtual 3D camera tilting and whipping around extruded text and tech frames
shots.composition: centered kinetic word (HOLY SHOT, NOT READY, AND NO, HELL, ONE) with small top-left caption pill; HUD corner brackets, 'CLAUDE - CODE' label top-right, REC dot bottom-left, timecode bottom-right; diagrams centered

elements.easing: ease-out letter reveals; letters stretch/morph (G of MOTION slides in from below, STRETCH. widens, THE blur-in); orange glowing dot/comet traces lines between boxes; typewriter prompt text; counters tick (9H, +4H)

text.role: two layers: big kinetic key word centered (white, orange or pink accent) plus small sentence-style caption pill top-left with the current word highlighted in an orange box (word-by-word, synced to voice)
text.weight: black for key words, regular for caption
text.case: UPPERCASE key words, sentence case captions
text.size_class: key words very large (up to ~35% of frame height); caption small
text.animation_in: word-by-word highlight box moves with voice; key words pop with glow; scene 6 letters blur-in then stretch wide; scene 7-8 extruded 3D letters whip in
text.animation_out: replaced at next phrase or cut

grade.look: near-black navy background with one orange accent (#FA954E class) and white type; pink/red used for NO and the time-spent counter; scene 6 flips to full flat orange with dark text; scene 9 flashes white

layout.safe_zones: inner video is 16:9 shown on a monitor in a vertical reel; only inner video described
layout.framing_notes: crop is 876x492 from a tracked screen quad; top edge of crop includes a bit of monitor frame and orange items on the desk (scene 1 also shows player controls at 0.7s: the video is about to start)

recipe.notes: Orange-on-black Claude Code HUD style: corner brackets, REC dot, timecode, dotted grid. Components: caption pill with moving highlight, centered kinetic word, node-diagram (CLAUDE -> MCP SERVER -> AFTER EFFECTS), prompt box with typewriter and orange highlighted phrases, timeline mock (After Effects Not Responding), 3D extruded text with camera, counter list (KEYFRAMES +4H, LAYERS +3H, AFTER EFFECTS +2H = 9H), pipeline CLAUDE -> PROMPT -> GENERATE, final logo 'Claude CODE by Edita Club'. Spring values estimated.
